# pvecli tag

Manage tags globally.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`add`](add.md) | Add or update a tag color in the cluster. |
| [`edit`](edit.md) | Rename a tag and/or change its color. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Remove one or more tags from all VMs and CTs in the cluster. |
| [`color`](color.md) | Manage color palette. |
| [`export`](export.md) | Export all tags and their colors to a JSON file. |
| [`import`](import.md) | Import tags and their colors from a JSON file. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all tags in the cluster. |
